media_deletion_state_check.name: media_deletion_state_check
media_deletion_state_check.value: ("media"."deletion_status" = 'NONE' AND "media"."deletion_requested_at" IS NULL AND "media"."deletion_requested_by" IS NULL AND "media"."deletion_attempts" = 0 AND "media"."deletion_last_attempt_at" IS NULL AND "media"."deletion_error_code" IS NULL) OR ("media"."deletion_status" IN ('REQUESTED','FAILED') AND "media"."deletion_requested_at" IS NOT NULL)

media_deletion_error_check.name: media_deletion_error_check
media_deletion_error_check.value: ("media"."deletion_status" != 'FAILED' OR "media"."deletion_error_code" IS NOT NULL) AND ("media"."deletion_error_code" IS NULL OR "media"."deletion_error_code" IN ('STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE','USAGE_CONFLICT','PROCESSING_CONFLICT','RETRY_EXHAUSTED'))
